**AR aging report, October 2026**
🔗 https://reports.halcyon.example/ar-aging/2026-10

| Days past due | Share | Approx. amount |
|---|---|---|
| Current | 61% | ~$2.94M |
| 1–30 days | 22% | ~$1.06M |
| 31–60 days | 9% | ~$433K |
| Over 60 days | 8% | ~$385K |

The amounts are my estimates from the percentages, so check the full report for exact numbers. About 17% (roughly $818K) is more than 30 days overdue, and that's probably where you'll want to look first.

If you'd like to compare October with yesterday's report or another month, tell me which month and I'll run it.
